node.statement: The registered definition one-dimensional-projection-nonvanishing supplies the missing bridge: one-dimensional means dim S_Q=1, hence S_Q is not zero; since S_Q=0 if and only if Q lies in the first (vanishing) P_alternatives branch, Q cannot lie in that branch and therefore lies in the second branch, i.e. Q is nonvanishing.
